consumer: domain visual-evaluation profile authors and deterministic integrators
outcome: Represent visual evidence relevance, subject eligibility, preference comparison, uncertainty, observation, and lifecycle without coupling the contract to one provider or domain.
uncoveredResponsibility: The current engineering rubric family provides the decision semantics and operation lifecycle, but no accepted provider-neutral profile contract directly represents visual evidence units and their relevance, duplication, occlusion, dimension coverage, and source-to-subject lineage.

localCoverage.reuse: Reuse Engineering Decision Rubric for criterion kinds, anchors, evidence states, and non-compensatory ordering; reuse Rubric Operation for task context, populations, validity, invalidation, and outcome observations.
localCoverage.composition: Compose Work Pattern Context Resolution for task-domain and responsibility boundaries with the existing bounded pipeline and fan-out/fan-in execution patterns.
localCoverage.improvement: Before any new unit, evaluate whether the Engineering Rubric owner should accept an additive visual-evidence profile adapter or whether the responsibility should remain a task-local profile.

compatibilityConstraints: Must not widen the four engineering decision families without the current semantic owner.
Must keep provider collection and authorization outside the rubric contract.
Must preserve existing task profiles and never reinterpret historical results under a new rubric revision.
Must keep mandatory and qualifying failures outside any preference calculation.
lifecycleConstraints: Start as a report-only candidate with an exact source digest.
Require independent cross-domain and cross-provider evidence before source promotion.
Require positive negative ambiguous conflicting failure recovery and invalidation cases.
Require a named owner maintainer migration rollback review and retirement path.
decisionDeadline: When a second materially different visual-evidence domain or provider and an independent semantic owner are available.
refreshTrigger: A current rubric owner adds a visual-evidence unit contract, or representative recurrence and counterexample evidence changes the gap fingerprint.
